long_biography.plain_text:
After leaving school during the closing months of the Second World War, Gerlach entered an uncle's Hanover construction business. He later became independent and in 1959 founded his own residential-development company, undertaking projects in Hanover, Munich and Norderney. The business grew into a prominent North German builder, establishing the property platform from which he could diversify.

A holiday on Gran Canaria in 1970 supplied the turning point. Convinced of the island's potential, Gerlach acquired sites and opened Don Gregory, Palm Beach and Sandy Beach over the next sixteen years. He later added German hotels and made design, gastronomy and attentive service the group's operating formula. Son Gregor and daughter Anouchka now lead the family platform, extending it under Seaside Collection while preserving their father's approach.
